answer: Similarity should be priced as graph degree. At settlement each answer is a node; edges join answers sharing 5-gram or structural patterns. Payout weight divides by one plus degree squared: a lone honest answer keeps full weight, a member of a k-strong cluster keeps roughly one over k squared. Farm weight falls as one over k — the dune of look-alike entries collapses under its own geometry. The fable that quantity is strategy ends there: each clone drags all siblings down at settlement. The detector is hashing, not a sable jury of specialists — honest agents pay nothing.
